items.text: The plastic hula hoop was first marketed in July 1958.
items.question: Who was the first person you knew to have a hula hoop, and who in your family could keep one going the longest?
items.source_quote: July – The plastic hula hoop is first marketed.

items.text: Danny & the Juniors' "At the Hop" was a number-one song on Billboard's charts in 1958.
items.question: Where did you hear "At the Hop" by Danny & the Juniors, on the radio or a jukebox, and who were you with?
source_quote: Prior to that, Billboard published four popular song charts
In 1958, twenty-five different songs were able to top one of the four charts.
The first song to top all three charts was Danny & the Juniors' "At the Hop".

items.text: Explorer 1, the first successful American satellite, was launched into orbit on January 31, 1958.
items.question: Where were you when you heard that Explorer 1, the first American satellite, was in orbit, and who told you?
items.source_quote: January 31 – The first successful American satellite, Explorer 1, is launched into orbit.

items.text: The Baltimore Colts beat the New York Giants 23 to 17 on December 28, 1958, to win the NFL Championship Game, the first to go into sudden death overtime.
items.question: Who did you watch or listen to the 1958 NFL Championship Game with, and who was rooting for the Colts or the Giants?
items.source_quote: December 28 – 1958 NFL Championship Game: The Baltimore Colts beat the New York Giants 23–17 to win the NFL Championship Game, the first to go into sudden death overtime and "The Greatest Game Ever Played".
